principles: Prefer current official maps, current-linked older official maps, official basic/seated examples, official event layouts, then reputable secondary numbered maps supported by non-contradictory official evidence.
Use the complete mapped seat-ID set for the declared representative scope; never delete seats to fit a published total.
Treat exact total agreement, independent second generation, rangeDiff 0, wheelchair/companion conversion, and complete variant coverage as confidence signals rather than production blockers.
Keep capacity fitting, repository-invented seat IDs, anonymous-image sourcing, invalid ranges, overlaps, and empty runtime sets as hard blockers.

confidence.verified: Official numbered map and total substantially reconcile with strong review evidence.
confidence.representative: Official basic/current-linked/typical map is used; event and accessibility differences may exist.
confidence.approximate: Official supporting evidence plus a reputable secondary numbered map provides the most reasonable representative layout.
